scholarships.title: Beca Doctoral PUCP - Programa de Apoyo a la Investigación Doctoral
scholarships.official_source: Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú (PUCP) - Vicerrectorado de Investigación and Escuela de Posgrado

eligibility: Ciudadanos peruanos o extranjeros que hayan obtenido su grado académico de maestro
Aspirar a cursar un doctorado en la PUCP con dedicación exclusiva y a tiempo completo
Contar con el aval de un asesor de la PUCP vinculado al programa doctoral
Dominio del idioma inglés a nivel B2 (MCER) o superior
Obtener la condición de ADMITIDO en el proceso de admisión 2027-1
existing.eligibility_summary: Peruvian or foreign citizens holding a master's degree who seek to enter a PUCP doctorate with exclusive full-time dedication, have the backing of a PUCP thesis adviser in that doctoral programme, and hold English at CEFR B2 or above.
benefits: Derechos académicos (tuition) and matrícula, covered by the Escuela de Posgrado
Asignación mensual de manutención de S/ 4,000 for 12 renewable months, paid by the Vicerrectorado de Investigación
Espacio de trabajo en el campus con acceso a recursos institucionales no monetarios (bibliotecas, laboratorios, equipos, uso de aulas)
coverage: Derechos académicos (tuition) and matrícula, covered by the Escuela de Posgrado
Asignación mensual de manutención de S/ 4,000 for 12 renewable months, paid by the Vicerrectorado de Investigación
Espacio de trabajo en el campus con acceso a recursos institucionales no monetarios (bibliotecas, laboratorios, equipos, uso de aulas)
requirements: Register in the Beca Doctoral 2027-1 admission process between 10 August and 4 November 2026
Obtain unconditional admission (ADMITIDO) from the doctoral programme applied to
Have the endorsement of a PUCP professor attached to that doctoral programme who will act as thesis adviser
Present an English certificate at B2 level or equivalent, or superior
Submit all seven documents listed in the bases
documents: Ensayo personal (statement of purpose) de extensión máxima de dos páginas
Proyecto de investigación doctoral de extensión máxima de cinco páginas
Hoja de vida con experiencia académica y profesional y producción científica
Dos cartas de recomendación presentadas directamente por los expertos que las suscriben, a través de la plataforma Kissflow designada por la Escuela de Posgrado
Carta de compromiso del asesor de tesis
Declaración de Ética e Integridad en la Investigación
Certificado de inglés con nivel B2 o superior
application_method: Apply through the Beca Doctoral 2027-1 admission process at the PUCP School of Postgraduate Studies
Have recommendation letters uploaded by the referees themselves through the Kissflow platform
existing.selection_notes: Candidates are scored on a 0 to 20 scale by the doctoral programme's own Directing Committee against four criteria: the doctoral research project, academic and research experience, the motivation letter, and the recommendation letters. A score of 18 or higher (90th percentile) is required to reach the selection stage. Selection is then made by the VRI on the strength of the final merit ranking, in two rounds: one grant for the best-ranked candidate of each doctoral programme that has eligible candidates, then the second-ranked candidates up to a maximum of two grantees per doctoral programme. Results are final and not appealable.
existing.best_fit: A master's graduate anywhere in the world who will enter a PUCP doctorate full time, has a named PUCP thesis adviser, holds English at CEFR B2 or above, and can commit to the exclusive dedication the programme demands.
existing.notes: The programme excludes PUCP full-time teaching staff and anyone who during doctoral studies holds a full-time executive, research or administrative post inside or outside PUCP. It also excludes the doctorates of Centrum PUCP and the Consortium of Universities' Doctorado en Gestión Estratégica. Applicants who have not graduated from PUCP receive differentiated registration-fee discounts between 10 August and 18 September and between 19 September and 12 October. The maintenance allowance is granted under the figure of a scholarship and is therefore not subject to withholdings.
existing.duration: One (1) calendar year, renewable up to two times; the benefit cannot extend beyond the three-year programme plan (four years for the Mathematics doctorate)
existing.application_period: 10/08/2026 to 04/11/2026 (registration in the 2027-1 doctoral admission process); eligibility review from 20/11/2026; beneficiary list published 03/12/2026; agreements signed 09/12/2026 to 11/12/2026
